title: 第19章 召唤决斗第20章 召唤
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
洗完澡后，躺好在床上的法伦，心中默念着系统，不一会便进入到了系统空间之中。
点开系统界面的五维属性，法伦看到自己的五维数值：
魅力95100
勇气35100
毅力17100
体魄14100
学力35100
“还剩五点魅力值就满了，不知道升一级以后会有什么变化，如果运气好的话，明天应该就能升级了。”
法伦看着自己的五维属性，喃喃自语道。
法伦关闭了五维属性的界面后，目光落在了任务列表上。
然而，令他惊讶的是，在以一年级学生身份入学阿瓦隆学院的任务下方竟然多出了一个子任务。
这个子任务要求他在种子选拔赛上获得前八名的成绩，并给予了一组全属性香薰组合I作为奖励。
这让法伦感到十分意外和兴奋，因为这是他首次在与系统相关的地方看到明确的奖励字样。
终于啊！
只有处决而没有奖励，这样的系统怎么能算是完整的呢？不过，这个香薰到底是什么东西呢？"
尽管看到了奖励，法伦内心充满喜悦，但对于奖励的具体物品，他却暂时还没想到是什么。
但结合上系统的名字，五维数值，左轮，他其实有个猜想了，现在就是需要明天的确认了。
再次确认了一下没有其他事要做，法伦退出了系统空间。
回到现实世界后，法伦把笔记本上的数据更新了一下，便躺下睡觉了。
周二清晨，晨曦初现，法伦睁开双眼，看了一眼时间：五点五十九分。

他微微一笑，心中暗自庆幸自己又一次成功避开了那生硬的叫醒服务。
迅速洗漱后，他穿上学校的运动服，充满活力地开启了新一天的早锻炼。
锻炼结束后，法伦迎着清晨的阳光走向食堂。
他熟练地点了一份营养早餐，然后带回宿舍。
由于第一节课是课外实训课，法伦决定今天不洗澡，而是选择直接享受早餐。
他坐在桌前，一边品尝着食物，一边翻阅着书籍，《东帝国地理图志》已经看完了三分之二，法伦估摸着明天就能把书还了。
早餐过后，法伦将银色左轮放进校服外套的口袋里，做了几次拔枪的动作，像是在模仿地球上的港产片警察一样，玩了一会，估摸时间差不多了，法伦便出发前往训练场。
法伦穿过学院的林荫小道，初春的清晨空气中弥漫着泥土和青草的芳香。
阳光透过树梢，洒下斑驳的光影，随着他轻快的步伐跳跃着。
训练场位于中心广场的另一边，一个足球场左右大小的场地，被划分为多个不同的对战区域和训练设施。
这里不仅是学生们进行体育活动和身体锻炼的地方，也是进行召唤师对战技巧训练的重要场所。
法伦到达训练场时，已经有不少同学在那里进行热身运动了。
他的目光在人群中扫过，很快就发现了千代和妮可的身影。
千代似乎正在练习一些基础的体术动作，动作流畅而有力，而妮可则是蹲在一旁观看，时不时打个哈欠。
千代一头柔顺的长发扎成了高高的马尾，随着她的动作轻轻摆动。
她的每一个动作都透露出武士的精准与优雅。
content_en:
After taking a shower, Fallon lay on the bed, thinking about the system silently in his mind, and soon entered the system space.
Clicking on the five-dimensional properties of the system interface, Fallon saw his five-dimensional values:
Charm 95100
Courage 35100
Perseverance 17100
Physique 14100
Academic ability 35100
"It's full with five charm points left. I don't know what will happen after upgrading. If I'm lucky, I should be able to upgrade tomorrow."
Fallon looked at his five-dimensional attributes and muttered to himself.
After Fallon closed the five-dimensional attribute interface, his eyes fell on the task list.
However, to his surprise, there was an additional sub-task beneath the task of enrolling in Avalon Academy as a first-year student.
This sub-task requires him to get among the top eight in the seed selection, and is given a full-attribute Aromatherapy Combination I as a reward.
This surprised and excited Fallon because it was the first time he had seen clear reward words anywhere related to the system.
Finally!
With only executions but no rewards, how can such a system be considered complete? But what exactly is this aromatherapy? "
Although Fallon was filled with joy when he saw the reward, he had not thought about the specific items of the reward yet.
But combined with the name of the system, the five-dimensional value, and the revolver, he actually has a guess, and now he needs to confirm it tomorrow.
After confirming again that there was nothing else to do, Fallon exited the system space.
After returning to the real world, Fallon updated the data on his laptop and lay down to sleep.
As dawn broke on Tuesday morning, Fallon opened his eyes and glanced at the time: five-fifty-nine.
He smiled slightly, secretly glad that he had once again successfully avoided the abrupt wake-up call.
After washing quickly, he put on his school sports clothes and energetically started his morning workout for the new day.
After the workout, Fallon walked toward the cafeteria in the early morning sunshine.
He skillfully ordered a nutritious breakfast and took it back to the dormitory.
Since the first class was an extracurricular practical training class, Fallon decided not to take a shower today, but chose to enjoy breakfast directly.
He sat at the table, tasting the food and flipping through the books. He had already read two-thirds of the "Geographical Map of the Eastern Empire", and Fallon estimated that he would return the book tomorrow.
After breakfast, Fallon put the silver revolver into the pocket of his school uniform jacket and made several gun-drawing movements, as if imitating the Hong Kong police on earth. After playing for a while, he estimated that the time was almost up, and then set off for the training ground.
Fallon walked through the college's tree-lined paths, the early spring morning air filled with the aroma of earth and grass.
The sun shines through the treetops, casting mottled light and shadow, jumping with his brisk pace.
The training ground is located on the other side of the central square. It is about the size of a football field and is divided into multiple different fighting areas and training facilities.
This is not only a place for students to carry out sports activities and physical exercises, but also an important place for summoner battle skills training.
When Fallon arrived at the training ground, many classmates were already there doing warm-up exercises.
His eyes scanned the crowd, and he quickly spotted Chiyo and Nico.
Chiyo seemed to be practicing some basic taijutsu movements, with smooth and powerful movements, while Nicole squatted aside and watched, yawning from time to time.
Chiyo's long, silky hair was tied into a high ponytail, swaying gently with her movements.
Every movement she makes reveals the precision and grace of a samurai.
